question: Should this PR's typed login-method contract and shared `Chrome (openclaw)` WhatsApp device identity become the canonical implementation, superseding https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866?
rationale: Both PRs are viable, but this choice establishes a public Plugin SDK contract and user-visible linked-device identity that automation cannot finalize without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt this PR
options.body: Use the capability-gated typed API, add exact-head live proof, and close the older PR as superseded only after this branch is viable.

options.title: Adopt the older PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866 if maintainers prefer its simpler API and existing physical-device proof.

options.title: Narrow the shared surface
options.body: Keep phone-code pairing plugin-local until maintainers agree on a more general public login-method contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR
recommendation.body: Use the capability-gated typed API, add exact-head live proof, and close the older PR as superseded only after this branch is viable.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned repository member owns the replacement API and is the clearest coordinator for canonical selection and proof.
